schema_metadata.description: Semantic distillation schema capsule for narrative fiction including novels, short stories, and creative prose.

protection.storage_guidelines: Immutable. Hash stored on-chain when necessary.
protection.ip_protection_notes: Schema capsule is designed to be self-contained for IP locking.

passes.name: Pass 1
passes.notes: Foundation pass - extract story overview (including premise), document structure, and tone. Keep focused to avoid token limits.

passes.name: Pass 2
passes.notes: Extract basic character info: name, role, description, character_arc, goals, flaws, motivations, backstory, voice_distinction, relationships, key_traits. Keep focused to avoid token limits.

passes.name: Pass 2b
passes.notes: Extract character depth: micro_mechanics (facial expressions, body language, tells, vocal tone), psychological_architecture (internal monologue, biases, trauma patterns, desire vs need), interaction_systems (influence patterns, dominance/submission, attraction/avoidance, mentor-student, rivalry). Focus on main characters first.

passes.name: Pass 3
passes.notes: Dedicated pass for plot structure - extract acts/chapters, inciting incident, climax, resolution, turning points, stakes, conflict, and key_choices with consequences

passes.name: Pass 4
passes.notes: Extract structured worldbuilding: geography, culture, technology/magic, politics, economy, lore, social_dynamics, environmental_metaphors, world_simulation_rules. Keep focused to avoid token limits.

passes.name: Pass 4b
passes.notes: CRITICAL: Extract ALL physical_objects_and_props with prop_logic (why_exists, how_got_there, consistent_behavior, triggers_plot_events, plot_events_triggered). These are plot-critical elements.

passes.name: Pass 5
passes.notes: Extract themes, symbolism, motifs, moral questions, and philosophical_moral_layers (ethical dilemmas, moral frameworks, personal codes, ideological clashes) - focused pass

passes.name: Pass 6
passes.notes: Extract quotes and dialogue for FIRST HALF of story: verbatim with subtext, silences/pauses - these serve as markers to prevent repetition during reinflation. For long stories, extract approximately the first half of all quotes/dialogue.

passes.name: Pass 6a
passes.notes: Extract quotes and dialogue for SECOND HALF of story: verbatim with subtext, silences/pauses. Extract the remaining quotes/dialogue not covered in Pass 6.

passes.name: Pass 7
passes.notes: Dedicated pass for narrative sequence - chronological vs narrative order, plus temporal_mechanics (flashbacks, flashforwards, time dilation, loops, subjective vs objective time)

passes.name: Pass 8
passes.notes: Extract scene basics for FIRST HALF of scenes: scene_id, chapter_or_act, location, characters_present, summary, purpose, key_dialogue, narrative_function, entry_tension, exit_consequence, exact_sequence_of_actions. For long stories with many scenes, extract approximately the first half of all scenes.

passes.name: Pass 8a
passes.notes: Extract scene basics for SECOND HALF of scenes: scene_id, chapter_or_act, location, characters_present, summary, purpose, key_dialogue, narrative_function, entry_tension, exit_consequence, exact_sequence_of_actions. Extract the remaining scenes not covered in Pass 8.

passes.name: Pass 8b
passes.notes: Extract scene details: physical_actions, micro_actions, sensory_details (all 5 senses - visual, sound, smell, touch, taste), emotional_beats, emotional_landing (new truth/power shift/goal change/emotional turn), sensory_absence (what's not seen/said, silence as agent, obscurity). Focus on key scenes first.

passes.name: Pass 9
passes.notes: Extract narrative flow (including breathing_room, emotional_beats, emotional_logic) and storytelling techniques (including narrative_authority, reader_manipulation tools)

passes.name: Pass 10
passes.notes: Extract narrative style - pacing, tone shifts, sentence structure, rhetorical/literary devices, dialogue/descriptive style, meta_layers (genre conventions, tropes, audience expectations, self-awareness), rhythm_and_cadence (sentence rhythm, paragraph choreography, scene length modulation, dialogue breath patterns)

passes.name: Pass 11
passes.notes: Extract macro-level cohesion: payoffs_to_setups, thematic_consistency, contrast, continuity (logical, emotional, plot, character), logistics_continuity (practical constraints, geography limitations, causality mapping, plot holes avoided). Also extract hidden_systems: audience_secrets, character_secrets, self_deception

passes.name: Pass 12
passes.notes: Extract observable layout patterns - critical for preserving original formatting

premise.description: The core idea or 'what if' that drives the story

goals.description: What the character wants to achieve

flaws.description: Character weaknesses, limitations, or negative traits

motivations.description: What drives the character's actions and decisions

backstory.description: Relevant history that shapes the character's behavior

character_arc.description: How the character changes throughout the story (growth, regression, or stasis)

voice_distinction.description: How this character speaks and thinks uniquely (speech patterns, vocabulary, thought style)

contradiction.description: What dialogue or behavior it contradicts

tells.description: Nervous habits, personal quirks, tells that reveal character

internal_monologue_structure.description: How the character's internal thoughts are structured

desire_vs_need_conflict.description: Conflict between what character wants vs what they need

method.description: How they influence (persuasion, manipulation, example, etc.)

other.description: The other person in the relationship

stakes.description: What could be gained or lost in the story

conflict.description: Types of conflict: internal, external, interpersonal, environmental

context.description: When and why the choice was made

consequences.description: Ripples and effects from this choice

key_choices.description: Major decisions that drive the plot

rules.description: Limitations, constraints, or rules of the system

scarcity_dynamics.description: What is scarce, what is abundant, economic pressures

important_past_events.description: Events that shape the current story

source.description: Source of power (wealth, status, knowledge, etc.)

space.description: Type of space (high_places, thresholds, enclosed_spaces, etc.)

resource_flows.description: How resources flow through the world

physics_constraints.description: Physical constraints that affect the story

cultural_evolution.description: How culture evolves and changes over time

world_building_elements.description: Additional world-building elements not covered above

name.description: Name or description of the physical object/prop

appears_in_scenes.description: Scene IDs or scene descriptions where this object appears

used_by_characters.description: Character names who interact with this object

is_evidence.description: Whether this object serves as proof or evidence in the story

why_exists.description: Why this prop exists in the story

how_got_there.description: How the prop got to where it is

consistent_behavior.description: How the prop behaves consistently over time

triggers_plot_events.description: Whether this prop triggers plot events

plot_events_triggered.description: What plot events this prop triggers

physical_objects_and_props.description: All significant physical objects, props, evidence items, and artifacts mentioned in the story

appearances.description: Where and how this motif appears

significance.description: What this motif represents or reinforces

motifs.description: Recurring patterns or images throughout the story

characters.description: Characters who operate under this framework

code.description: Personal code of honor or ethics

violations.description: When/how this code is violated or tested

tropes_subverted.description: Tropes that are subverted or inverted

audience_expectations.description: What expectations the story sets up or plays with

self_awareness.description: Whether the story is self-aware or meta-commentary

meta_commentary.description: Instances of meta-commentary on storytelling, genre, or narrative itself

sentence_rhythm.description: Patterns in sentence rhythm (short/long, staccato/flowing, etc.)

paragraph_choreography.description: How paragraphs are structured and flow

scene_length_modulation.description: How scene lengths vary (short action scenes, long reflection scenes, etc.)

dialogue_breath_patterns.description: Breath patterns in dialogue (pauses, interruptions, overlapping speech)

speaker.description: Who said this quote (character name or narrator)

recipient.description: Who this quote is addressed to (character name, audience, or null if internal monologue/narration)

conversation_participants.description: All characters present in the conversation/exchange this quote is part of

context.description: Narrative context: what's happening in the story when this is said

conversation_context.description: Conversation context: what topic/subject is being discussed, what prompted this quote

subtext.description: What the character means but doesn't explicitly say

has_silence_or_pause.description: Whether there are meaningful silences or pauses around this dialogue

timeline_consistency.description: How timeline consistency is maintained or broken

time_dilation.description: Instances where time moves at different rates

subjective_vs_objective_time.description: Instances where subjective time perception differs from objective time

entry_tension.description: What energy or conflict starts the scene

exit_consequence.description: What changes by the end of the scene

physical_actions.description: Movement, fights, tasks, rituals - major physical actions

micro_actions.description: Small behaviors that reveal character (gestures, expressions, subtle movements)

emotional_beats.description: Shifts in feeling throughout the scene

new_truth.description: A new truth revealed by scene end

landing_type.description: Which type of landing (new_truth, power_shift, goal_change, emotional_turn)

emotional_landing.description: The Rule of Emotional Landing - what the scene ends with

what_not_seen.description: What isn't seen but is significant

what_not_said.description: What isn't said but is significant

silence_as_agent.description: Whether silence acts as a narrative agent

obscurity.description: Darkness, fog, obscurity that affects the scene

sensory_absence.description: Sensory absence - what's missing is as important as what's present

position.description: Where in the narrative this occurs

description.description: What happens during this breathing room

purpose.description: Why this pause is needed (emotional cooldown, reflection, etc.)

breathing_room.description: Emotional cooldown periods between intense events

position.description: Where in the narrative this occurs

emotional_beats.description: Major emotional shifts throughout the story

emotional_continuity.description: Emotional continuity from scene to scene

reliability.description: How reliable is the narrator (reliable, unreliable, partially_reliable, unknown)

framing_device.description: How the story is framed (journal, documentary, testimony, myth, direct_narration, etc.)

purpose.description: What it misleads the reader about

resolved.description: Whether this thread is eventually resolved

payoff.description: How it was resolved or paid off

payoffs_to_setups.description: Everything introduced must serve purpose - track setups and their payoffs

reinforcement.description: How this element reinforces the theme

element.description: What story element reinforces this (character, plot point, symbol, etc.)

thematic_consistency.description: How every major element reinforces the theme

elements.description: What is being contrasted (e.g., 'light vs dark', 'calm vs chaos')

instances.description: Where and how this contrast appears

contrast.description: Contrasting elements that create tension or meaning

logical_consistency.description: How plot logic is maintained throughout

plot_consistency.description: How plot threads are maintained and resolved

character_consistency.description: How character behavior and development is consistent

continuity.description: Logical, emotional, and plot consistency throughout the story

geography_limitations.description: Geography-driven limitations that affect the plot

plot_holes_avoided.description: How potential plot holes are avoided or addressed

secret.description: Secret the audience doesn't know yet

audience_secrets.description: Secrets the audience doesn't know yet

from_whom.description: Who the secret is kept from

character_secrets.description: Secrets characters keep from each other

secret.description: Secret the character keeps from themselves

section_numbering_style.description: How sections are numbered: 'arabic' (1, 2, 3), 'roman' (I, II, III), 'chapter' (Chapter 1), 'none', etc.

section_markers.description: Observable section break markers (e.g., '***', '---', blank lines)

operational_guidance.intended_use: Semantic distillation of narrative fiction including novels, short stories, and creative prose.

migration.notes: Enhanced with narrative sequence, scenes, narrative flow, storytelling techniques, and improved dialogue mapping. Added detailed narrative style characteristics.
